I am an old woman of eighty with no schooling, and this is my small piece of land where I plant cassava and cocoyam together the way my mother taught me. I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much for only 0.06 hectares, but I will put compost and chicken droppings from behind my house since I own this land and want to keep the soil soft. I use my own cuttings from last season, I do not spray or irrigate because the rain is enough here, and my family will work about eighteen days since we have no money for hired labor.
